items.title: Perforated Diamond Dot DXF Panel for CNC Privacy Screens
items.description: Free to use, this piece has small diamond-shaped perforations arranged in gently curving rows across the entire panel, growing slightly larger toward the bottom edge. The subtle size gradient gives this otherwise simple dot pattern a quiet sense of movement and depth.

items.title: Layered Rose Bloom DXF Panel for Romantic Feature Walls
items.description: Three oversized rose blooms stack from top to bottom, their overlapping petals rendered in bold faceted outlines for a striking floral statement. This romantic design suits feature walls, headboards, and decorative garden panels.

items.title: Symmetrical Baroque Filigree Crest Architectural Privacy Panel
items.description: An elegant, high-privacy vertical screen featuring heavily mirrored baroque filigree and classical scroll crests. The symmetrical design flows from top to bottom, creating a complex, balanced web of royal ornamentation with thick, sturdy vectors.
